data.body: 01e8 (init divergent-store) resolved and closed [plan_defect] — merged as Gerrit 1173 / origin main 4034e96388 (LLM-Review+1, Verified+1). Finding: the original symptom (single-branch clone bootstrapping a divergent empty store) NO LONGER reproduces on main — the landed explicit-refspec self-heal (5546/35f7) adopts origin/tickets (covered by test_sync_narrow_refspec). The one real remaining gap was AC3: rebar fsck mislabeled a genuinely divergent tracker as informational PUSH_PENDING / 'no issues found'. Fixed: fsck now classifies tracker-vs-origin using the same taxonomy as _store/sync.py and reports DIVERGED (no shared history, or non-fast-forwardable) as a COUNTED, non-zero issue naming the recovery path. This also delivers AC2's 'no silent data-hiding' intent via the health check; no init.py rearchitecture needed. Next: 983f is now UNBLOCKED — bounding the two _commands network git calls (init fetch, fsck_repair push).
